A '''variant''' of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] with additional appendages was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Some of those appendages were identical to the arms and hands of the typical B2, though the droid possessed more than two of them. The other ended with [[Circular saw/Legends|buzzsaws]] and could be used by the droid in hand-to-hand combat. One such droid was spotted on [[Simocadia]], when the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] attempt to take over the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] guarding a Republic [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] mine. The droid used his multiple hand appendages to wrestle with the clone trooper, while using his buzzsaws to inflict damage to him.
